title: The sooner you report, the more can be done.
subtitle: Take a breath. You're in the right place. Tell us what happened, in your own words. No ID upload, no forms: sign in once and we fill in what we already know.

trust.label: Signed in once, then straight to it
Nothing you submit is sold or shared

categoryPicker.title: What happened to you?
categoryPicker.subtitle: Not sure exactly what to call it? That's okay. Pick whatever feels closest. The examples show what's inside each one, and we'll get you to the right place either way.
categoryPicker.notBuiltBadge: Not built in this prototype yet

items.title: Money was taken from my account
items.body: Any fraud where money left you, however it started.
examples: UPI, net banking or card fraud
A KYC, OTP or “account will be blocked” call
Fake police, CBI or “digital arrest” call

items.title: Threats, harassment, or blackmail
items.body: Someone is threatening, harassing or pressuring you online.
examples: Stalking, or someone who won't stop
A fake profile pretending to be you
Loan app agents contacting your family or office

items.title: Account hacked, identity misused, or something else
items.body: Your account, device or identity has been taken over or used without you.
examples: Social media or email account hacked
Your Aadhaar, PAN or documents used to take a loan, card or SIM
Anything that doesn't fit the two above

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps. No forms, no wait to find out what happens next.

steps.title: Tell us what happened
steps.body: Write it in your own words. There's no right way to say it, and no minimum length.

steps.title: Confirm the facts
steps.body: We pull out the amount, date and reference automatically. You check it and confirm.

steps.title: Filed instantly
steps.body: You get a Complaint ID the moment you submit: nothing to wait on, nothing to follow up for.

steps.title: Track anytime
steps.body: Come back with your Complaint ID whenever you want to see exactly where your case stands.

trustImageAlt: A smiling woman working confidently on her laptop.

trustSection.title: Why this is safe to use right now

items.title: Signed in once, then straight to it
items.body: One sign-in with the number you already have. After that your details fill themselves in, every time.

items.title: Report in under 90 seconds
items.body: One question at a time, in plain language. We only ask for what's actually needed.

items.title: Nothing you submit is sold or shared
items.body: Your report goes only to the process that handles it. Nothing more.
